[d0708] cli | pq snapshot purge | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot purge`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Purges a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot purge <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--retain-days` | Number of days the result is kept before it is deleted automatically. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |

## Example
```
pq snapshot purge orders --since
```

[d0188] cli | pq topic purge | version 4.x
# `pq topic purge`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Purges a topic.

## Usage
```
pq topic purge <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--output` | Output format: `table`, `json` or `yaml`. Default: `table`. |

## Example
```
pq topic purge orders --since
```

response.content: `--since` limits the purge to objects created after a specified timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
